relations.reading: Evidence that a useful capability exists may justify a bounded search, while discovery, ownership, scale-up permission and realized value remain separate questions.

relations.title: Activación entre tipos de frontera
relations.reading: Cross-frontier activation needs an observed encounter and a justified capability link; a shared mathematical region alone does not supply either.

relations.title: Arbitraje de recursos
relations.reading: The cartography overlay adds an encounter gate to the two-provider model; its four observers and geometric score are separate from physical resources and realized mission output.

relations.title: Autoridad de decisión
relations.reading: Chosen solidarity needs an admissible transition with resources and consent, not merely a desirable end state or an aggregate score.
